remarks: Stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment nestled in the charming Byram neighborhood of Greenwich. Meticulously renovated, this second-floor, two-level residence offers the perfect blend of modern sophistication and comfortable living.  Step inside and be captivated by the gleaming hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The large eat-in kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, featuring top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and luxurious granite countertops that provide both style and functionality. With three spacious bedrooms and an additional den, this apartment offers ample space for living, working, and relaxing. The private washer and dryer in the basement add convenience to your daily routine, while the one off-street parking spot ensures hassle-free parking. Located just a short walk from Byram Park, this apartment offers the perfect balance of convenience and natural beauty. Enjoy easy access to local amenities, parks, and the vibrant Greenwich community. This completely renovated apartment is waiting to become your new home. Don't miss this opportunity to experience refined living in one of Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods.
